description: A read on a POST route: the empty body goes out, the samples come back untyped, and the envelope reports them beside the service type it was asked for. service_type is checked by the same slug rule the sibling alert-definition delete carries, so an absent, uppercase or path-bearing value answers one sentence in both languages.

cases.name: requires service_type
cases.expect_error: service_type must be a single non-empty service type slug

cases.name: rejects a path separator in service_type
cases.expect_error: service_type must be a single non-empty service type slug

cases.name: rejects a traversal service_type
cases.expect_error: service_type must be a single non-empty service type slug

cases.name: rejects an uppercase service_type
cases.expect_error: service_type must be a single non-empty service type slug

cases.name: rejects a non-text service_type
cases.expect_error: service_type must be a single non-empty service type slug

cases.name: rejects a surrounding-space service_type
cases.expect_error: service_type must be a single non-empty service type slug

cases.name: posts the empty body to the metrics route
reports the samples under the service type it was asked for
rejects a bare-array API response
cases.expect_api_error: monitor service metric query response must be a JSON object

cases.name: rejects a bare-string API response
cases.expect_api_error: monitor service metric query response must be a JSON object

cases.name: reports the API failure under the declared sentence
cases.expect_api_error: Failed to retrieve monitor service metrics for 'dbaas'
